I need to fix the typo in the TextEdit document. The current text is "Teh report is ready.\nSee attached.\n" and I need to change "Teh" to "The". 

First, I should activate the TextEdit app to make sure it's in front, then use the fill function to replace the text.

Let me start by activating the app:

ok

Good, the app is active. Now I need to fill the textarea with the corrected text. The current value is 'Teh report is ready.\nSee attached.\n'. I need to change it to 'The report is ready.\nSee attached.\n'.

Let me use the fill function:

See attached.

text:
Perfect! The text has been corrected from "Teh" to "The". Now I need to save the document. The menu command available is "文件 > 保存" which means "File > Save".

Let me execute that menu command:

ok

text:
Excellent! The document has been saved successfully. The typo has been fixed - "Teh" is now "The", and the document has been saved. The task is complete.
